uncited: **Fill Ghost Layers:** The received data is placed into the appropriate ghost layer positions.
Layer 1 (Inner Ghost) is adjacent to the local data boundary.
- **Trilinear Interpolation:** Requires access to 8 neighboring voxels.
- **Boundary Conditions:** The outermost ghost layers (Layer 2) do not have neighbors to exchange with.
- **Memory Complexity:** The memory overhead is proportional to the surface area of the local macro times the number of ghost layers.
The concept of ghost data exchange in volume rendering was discussed in the context of MPI-hybrid parallelism for large, multi-core systems.
